[All packages](README.md)

Types: [`IGoggles`](#igoggles), [`IRevealer`](#irevealer), [`IVisDiscountGear`](#ivisdiscountgear), [`ItemsTC`](#itemstc)

## IGoggles

```java
public interface IGoggles extends thaumcraft.api.IGoggles
```

Thaumcraft 6 compatibility alias for addons compiled against the 1.12 API.

Legacy `src/main/java/thaumcraft/api/items/IGoggles.java`: the alias carries no member of its own, it only names the canonical `thaumcraft.api.IGoggles` contract, which the native port publishes at `thaumcraft/api/IGoggles.java`.

## IVisDiscountGear

```java
public interface IVisDiscountGear extends thaumcraft.api.IVisDiscountGear
```

Thaumcraft 6 compatibility interface for addons compiled against the 1.12 API.

Legacy `src/main/java/thaumcraft/api/items/IVisDiscountGear.java`: the alias keeps the two argument overload of the 1.12 API and answers the canonical three argument contract from it. The canonical contract itself is published at `thaumcraft/api/IVisDiscountGear.java`.

default int getVisDiscount(ItemStack stack, Player player, Aspect aspect)

## ItemsTC

```java
public final class ItemsTC
```

The public item registry of the native port.

Forced 1.21.1 change: the original TC4 kept its items in `ConfigItems` and the original add-on surface kept them in `ItemsTC`; 1.21.1 registers every item in the item registry, so this class resolves the native registry instead of holding a second copy of it. A plain name means `thaumcraft:<name>`.

An original TC4 field name of `ConfigItems` or `ConfigBlocks` (`"itemThaumometer"`, `"blockJar"`) is accepted too and means the item of its metadata 0, the original `new ItemStack(ConfigItems.field)`; `get(String, int)` selects another metadata. The names and metadata resolve through `ItemApi.legacyItemId` (`docs/api/LEGACY_IDS.md`).

<a id="itemstc-id"></a>
```java
public static ResourceLocation id(String name)
```

Null/empty names throw IllegalArgumentException; malformed namespaced IDs return null, malformed plain paths throw ResourceLocationException. An original field name answers the item of its metadata 0, or null when 1.21.1 has none; it never throws.

<a id="itemstc-get"></a>
```java
public static Item get(String name)
```

Missing items return null; null/empty and malformed names follow `id(String)` rather than a uniformly forgiving lookup.

<a id="itemstc-get-2"></a>
```java
public static Item get(String name, int metadata)
```

The item of an original field name and metadata (`get("itemResource", 2)` is the thaumium ingot), or null for an unknown metadata, a variant without a 1.21.1 item or an unregistered item. For any other name the metadata is ignored: a native id names one item.

<a id="itemstc-islegacyname"></a>
```java
public static boolean isLegacyName(String name)
```

True when the name is an original TC4 `ConfigItems` or `ConfigBlocks` field.

<a id="itemstc-require"></a>
```java
public static Item require(String name)
```

Null/empty or missing names throw IllegalArgumentException; malformed plain paths throw ResourceLocationException.

<a id="itemstc-stack"></a>
```java
public static ItemStack stack(String name)
```

A stack of the named item.

<a id="itemstc-stack-2"></a>
```java
public static ItemStack stack(String name, int count)
```

A stack of the named item.

<a id="itemstc-isregistered"></a>
```java
public static boolean isRegistered(String name)
```

True when the name is a registered item.

<a id="itemstc-names"></a>
```java
public static Set<String> names()
```

Every registered item of this mod.

<a id="itemstc-material"></a>
